name: Enel
effect:
Under the rules of this game, your DON!! deck consists of 6 cards.
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If it is your second turn or later, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active, and add up to 4 additional DON!! cards and rest them. Then, give up to 4 rested DON!! cards to 1 of your Characters.

variants.label: Standard
variants.artist: TV animation ONE PIECE Zhiguang Liu

official_faq.question: After a match has started, if this Leader's effect is negated by another card, what happens to my DON!! deck?
official_faq.answer: In this case, the number of cards in your DON!! deck will not change, and you can continue to use a total of 6 DON!! cards between your field and DON!! deck.

official_faq.question: What happens if I use this [Activate: Main] effect on my first turn?
official_faq.answer: If used on the first turn, you will be unable to use this [Activate: Main] effect to add or give any DON!! cards. If used on the second turn or later, you will be able to "add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active, and add up to 4 additional DON!! cards and rest them. Then, give up to 4 rested DON!! cards to 1 of your Characters." as described in the effect.

official_faq.question: When using this card as Leader, do I have to prepare 10 DON!! cards to play the game?
official_faq.answer: No, playing with just 6 DON!! cards will suffice.
